name: suite2p registration

params.name: Raw Binary Movie
params.description: Input raw suite2p binary movie [<data_raw>.bin]

params.name: Parameters file
params.description: Input suite2p parameters file, as outputted by the binary conversion tool [<ops_binary_conversion>.npy]

params.name: Frames to Include
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <frames_include>] "If greater than zero, only [the first] <frames_include> frames are processed. Useful for testing parameters on a subset of data." Note that suite2p will not run on less than 50 frames, and might have unpredictable behavior on less than 200 frames [int, -1 or >=50]

params.name: Align By Channel
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <align_by_chan>] "Which channel to use for alignment (1-based, so 1 means 1st channel and 2 means 2nd channel). If you have a non-functional channel with something like td-Tomato expression, you may want to use this channel for alignment rather than the functional channel." [int, [1 <nchannels>]]

params.name: Number of Frames for Initialization
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <nimg_init>] "How many frames to use to compute reference image for registration." [int, >=1]

params.name: Batch Size
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <batch_size>] "How many frames to register simultaneously in each batch. This depends on memory constraints - it will be faster to run if the batch is larger, but it will require more RAM." [int, >=1]

params.name: Maximum Registration Shift
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <maxregshift>] "The maximum shift as a fraction of the frame size. If the frame is Ly pixels x Lx pixels, then the maximum pixel shift in pixels will be max(Ly,Lx) * ops['maxregshift']." [float, [0.01 1]]

params.name: Smooth Sigma
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <smooth_sigma>] "Standard deviation in pixels of the gaussian used to smooth the phase correlation between the reference image and the frame which is being registered. A value of >4 is recommended for one-photon recordings (with a 512x512 pixel FOV)." [float, >=0.01]

params.name: Smooth Sigma Time
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <smooth_sigma_time>] "Standard deviation in time frames of the gaussian used to smooth the data before phase correlation is computed. Might need this to be set to 1 or 2 for low SNR data." [float, >=0]

params.name: Two-Step Registration
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <two_step_registration>] "Whether or not to run registration twice (for low SNR data). `keep_movie_raw` must be True for this to work." [bool]

params.name: Subpixel
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <subpixel>] "Precision of Subpixel Registration (1/subpixel steps)." [float, >=1]

params.name: Threshold for Bad Frames
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <th_badframes>] "Involved with setting threshold for excluding frames for cropping. Set this smaller to exclude more frames." [float, >=0]

params.name: Normalize Frames
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <norm_frames>] "Normalize frames when detecting shifts." [bool]

params.name: Force refImg
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <force_refImg>] "Specifies whether to use refImg stored in ops. Make sure that ops['refImg'] has a valid file pathname." [bool]

params.name: Pad FFT
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <pad_fft>] "Specifies whether to pad image or not during FFT portion of registration." [bool]

params.name: 1P Registration
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <1Preg>] "Whether to perform high-pass spatial filtering and tapering (parameters set below), which help with 1P registration." [bool]

params.name: Spatial HP Registration
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <spatial_hp_reg>] "Window in pixels for spatial high-pass filtering before registration." [int, >=1]

params.name: Pre Smooth
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <pre_smooth>] "If > 0, defines stddev of Gaussian smoothing, which is applied before spatial high-pass filtering." [float]

params.name: Spatial Taper
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <spatial_taper>] "How many pixels to ignore on edges - they are set to zero (important for vignetted windows, for FFT padding do not set BELOW 3*ops['smooth_sigma'])." [float, >=0]

params.name: Nonrigid Registration
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <nonrigid>] "Whether or not to perform non-rigid registration, which splits the field of view into blocks and computes registration offsets in each block separately." [bool]

params.name: Block Size
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <block_size>] "Size of blocks for non-rigid registration, in pixels. HIGHLY recommend keeping this a power of 2 and/or 3 (e.g. 128, 256, 384, etc) for efficient FFT." [list[int, int] with int > 1]

params.name: SNR Threshold
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <snr_thresh>] "How big the phase correlation peak has to be relative to the noise in the phase correlation map for the block shift to be accepted. In low SNR recordings like one-photon, I'd recommend a larger value like 1.5, so that block shifts are only accepted if there is significant SNR in the phase correlation." [float, >0]

params.name: Maximum Registration Shift for Nonrigid
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <maxregshiftNR>] "Maximum shift in pixels of a block relative to the rigid shift." [float, >=0]

params.name: Compute Bidirectional Phase Offset
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <do_bidiphase>] "Whether or not to compute bidirectional phase offset from misaligned line scanning experiment (applies to 2P recordings only). suite2p will estimate the bidirectional phase offset from ops['nimg_init'] frames if this is set to 1 (and ops['bidiphase']=0), and then apply this computed offset to all frames." [bool]

params.name: Bidirectional Phase Offset
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <bidiphase>] "Bidirectional phase offset from line scanning (set by user). If set to any value besides 0, then this offset is used and applied to all frames in the recording." [int, >=0]

params.name: Bidirectional Correction
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <bidi_corrected>] "Specifies whether to do bidi correction." [bool]

params.name: FOV vmin Percentile
params.description: Minimum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, [0 <FOV vmax Percentile>)]

params.name: FOV vmax Percentile
params.description: Maximum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, (<FOV vmin Percentile> 100]]

params.name: FOV Colormap
params.description: Colormap for plotting the FOV [str]

params.name: Show Grid on FOV
params.description: Whether or not to show the grid on FOVs [bool]

params.name: FOV Ticks Step
params.description: Step for the x- and y-ticks [int, >0]

params.name: Movie Display Rate
params.description: Display rate for the preview movies, in Hz [float, >=0.1]

results.name: Registration Output Parameters File
results.description: Parameters file outputted by the registration tool

description: Tool to run suite2p registration on a raw suite2p binary movie
